strategy.summary: At the buggy commit 631465d11f35e0dfbc2629434a7a9c26fc9dd8d, f32 softplus is effectively computed as log(exp(beta*x)+1) before any overflow guards. For beta*x above about 88.7 in f32, exp overflows to inf, softplus returns inf, and autodiff produces NaN gradients for saturated inputs; for very negative beta*x, 1+exp(beta*x) underflows and the negative tail returns 0. PR #5374 / issue #5373 fixes this by using a threshold, capping the exp argument, and applying log1p. This plan adds only the PR's test assertions to the buggy tree and runs the CI test command, expecting those assertions to fail before any production fix is applied.
